verdict.rationale: Capacities documents a first-party Graph view in which links between notes become lines, showing the local neighbourhood of the open note. It can also open a graph scoped to a collection, tag, query, object-type dashboard or extended search, which covers the 'filtered to what I care about' part. However, the evidence only describes local or scoped graphs, not exploring the whole knowledge base, and it never documents interactive behaviour. Missing for 10: evidence of a global whole-knowledge-base graph, documented interactive exploration controls (navigating, expanding or filtering within the graph itself), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a researcher, I can explore my knowledge base as an interactive graph of notes and connections, filtered to what I care about

citations.quote: Each link between notes becomes a line in the graph, so you can see the local neighbourhood around the note you have open.
You can also open a graph on a collection, a tag, a query, an object type dashboard, or in extended search.
